perks.name: The Ceremony
perks.description: Finishing combatants or reviving allies initiates a Lucent Hive ritual. While the ritual is active, gain increased Super stat.
perks.exact:
On Finisher or Ally Revival:
Initiates a Ceremony for 30 seconds.
Additional Finishers/Revivals extends the buff duration to 30 seconds.

While Ceremony is active:
+30 Super Stat.

perks.name: Lucent Swarm
perks.description: Collecting Orbs of Power extends the Ceremony. While it is active, ability final blows occasionally spawn allied Arc moths.
perks.exact:
On Orb of Power Pickup:
Extends the Ceremony duration to 30 seconds.

While Ceremony is active:
Scoring 2 Ability Kills spawns a Loyal Arc Moth that lingers for 8 seconds.
Loyal Arc Moths relentlessly chase the closest enemy within 60+👀 meters, dealing up to 180 Arc Damage and inflicting blind for 8 seconds over ~6? meters.
Anything that would discharge Bolt Charge counts, including Unpowered Melee Kills and Forerunner's Rock EXCEPT FOR PRAXIC BLADE😔.
Arc Moth Damage is considered Generic Arc Damage. Does not benefit from Grenade, Melee, or Ability buffs nor does it interact with them.

item.name: Heavy Ammo Finder
item.description: Increases the effect of all contributions towards the Heavy ammo meter.
item.exact:
Special Ammo Finders:
1.25x | 1.4x | 1.5x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

Heavy Ammo Finders:
1.33x | 1.66x | 2x Ammo Progress Multiplier.

item.name: Void Siphon
item.description: Rapid Void weapon final blows create an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
Upon scoring 2 Mod-Element Matching Weapon Kills within 3 seconds of each:

Spawns an Orb of Power.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown upon spawning an Orbs of Power before additional kills count.

Orb of Power:
2.5% | 3.75% | 4.4% Super Energy.
